title: O2 Sensor Circuit Low Voltage Bank 1 Sensor 3
shortDescription: PCM detected: o2 sensor circuit low voltage bank 1 sensor 3 fault.
fullDescription:
This DTC indicates o2 sensor circuit low voltage bank 1 sensor 3 fault. The PCM watches O2 sensor activity, switching rate, and post-cat correlation; when the sensor fails to switch or response is slow the code matures.

Expect catalyst-readiness incompletion and potentially failed emissions inspection.
safetyImpact: Increased emissions; potential failed inspection.

fixSteps.title: Scan and capture freeze frame
fixSteps.instruction: Read all stored and pending codes; record freeze-frame data.

fixSteps.title: Visual inspection
fixSteps.instruction: Inspect related sensors, harness, connectors, and components for damage, corrosion, or contamination.

fixSteps.title: Electrical/functional test
fixSteps.instruction: Verify reference, ground, and signal at the affected connector; perform manufacturer-specific actuator/monitor test.

fixSteps.title: Replace component or perform service procedure
fixSteps.instruction: If circuit checks pass, replace the suspect component or perform required relearn and clear codes.

faq.a: Yes for short distances if engine runs normally; otherwise flatbed.
No - sensor or component replacement is typically required.

title: Fuel Temperature Sensor B Circuit
shortDescription: PCM detected: fuel temperature sensor b circuit fault.
fullDescription:
This DTC indicates fuel temperature sensor b circuit fault. The PCM uses temperature inputs for cold-start enrichment, viscosity-based timing, and protection strategies; an out-of-range or stuck-value sensor matures the code.

Cold-start performance and oil-protection logic may be affected.
safetyImpact: Drivable; cold-start may be rough.

title: Fuel Level Sensor B Circuit
shortDescription: PCM detected: fuel level sensor b circuit fault.
fullDescription:
This DTC indicates fuel level sensor b circuit fault. The PCM monitors auxiliary fuel level, ethanol/biodiesel composition, lift-pump current, and reductant heater operation; when a circuit or signal goes out of spec the code matures.

Flex-fuel and diesel vehicles require accurate composition and reductant data — limp mode and DEF inducement are possible.
safetyImpact: Drivability degraded; possible derate or restart limit.

causes.cause: Lift pump worn or wiring open

Transmission may enter limp mode (single gear) to protect internals.
safetyImpact: Limp mode reduces speed; safe-park then service.

title: TCM Power Relay Sense Circuit Low
shortDescription: PCM detected: tcm power relay sense circuit low fault.
fullDescription:
This DTC indicates tcm power relay sense circuit low fault. The TCCM monitors relay feedback, fluid degradation algorithm, and internal logic; when feedback is implausible or internal self-test fails the code matures.

4WD/AWD engagement may be inhibited; vehicle reverts to default drive mode.
safetyImpact: AWD/4WD unavailable; reduced traction in low grip.

causes.cause: Wiring/connector to transfer case shift motor
Worn transfer case fluid (extended drain interval)

symptoms: Stuck in 2WD or AWD won't engage

title: ECM Internal Performance
shortDescription: PCM detected: ecm internal performance fault.
fullDescription:
This DTC indicates ecm internal performance fault. The ECM/PCM runs continuous self-tests on memory, power-down logic, and signal-processing ASICs; when a self-test fails, the module sets the code and may enter limp or default mode.

Internal ECM faults often require module replacement or reflash with security access.
safetyImpact: Possible no-start or limp; service immediately.

title: ECM Internal Power-Down Logic Fault
shortDescription: PCM detected: ecm internal power-down logic fault fault.
fullDescription:
This DTC indicates ecm internal power-down logic fault fault. The ECM/PCM runs continuous self-tests on memory, power-down logic, and signal-processing ASICs; when a self-test fails, the module sets the code and may enter limp or default mode.

Internal ECM faults often require module replacement or reflash with security access.
safetyImpact: Possible no-start or limp; service immediately.
